beats.what: Lynn turns Pat's flat-rate pitch into a sliding scale, pricing each client by how badly he needs her and demanding her school fees on top
Lynn opens her father's cabinet at night and reads through the school's fee paperwork
Lynn asks her father why he moved her to this school; he says it was for the chance he never had, then takes his pills
Lynn drills her paying clients in a four-chord piano code for the answers and caps how high their scores may go
The final exam runs: Lynn taps the chords on her desk and client after client fills in the bubbles
Lynn's bank book shows deposits climbing into the hundreds of thousands, and she tells her father the money comes from teaching piano to a rich classmate
Word spreads and Pat lines up new buyers while the school hangs a banner honouring Lynn's scholarship
Sick with nerves before the Teen Genius taping, Bank warms to Lynn backstage and bumps fists with her as her teammate
On air Bank answers by reciting pi from memory, and the win puts him and Lynn in the teacher's office, where she offers them a free Singapore Institute scholarship exam
The teacher adds that only one student per school can have the scholarship, turning Lynn and Bank into rivals
At the family laundry Bank finds his mother scrubbing with an injured hand, abandons his textbook and takes over the tubs
Tong offers Bank 3,000 baht to cheat for him; Bank refuses and walks off down the corridor
The group scholarship exam opens, candidates spaced out across the hall and forbidden to sit together
Bank sweats and stalls on the last questions while a candidate's query to the proctor exposes that two different question sets are in the room
